review.headline: Easy 9 km done as prescribed at 5:46/km, steady and well inside the easy band.
observations: Full 9.0 km at 5:46/km average, every km split at 346s, inside the 5:11-6:13/km easy target.
Average HR 139 and max 142, comfortably aerobic and consistent with recent easy runs (137-140 bpm).
Efficiency 1.249 sits in line with the recent easy-run trend, and cadence held steady at 174 spm.
Even splits and HR throughout suggest a controlled, conversational effort.
flags: Athlete RPE and note were not logged (both 0 and blank), so perceived effort can't be confirmed.
Weekly volume is running well below plan (24.8 km actual vs 43.4 km planned in week 3), and CTL has slipped to 41.7.
